commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Alex Sola (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
90+7' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Iago Aspas leaves the pitch and Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) comes on.
90+4' 1 - 1 Goal! Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
90+3' Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) takes a short corner kick.
90+3' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Alex Remiro produces a wonderful reflex save.
90+3' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner with a short pass.

90+3' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Alex Remiro, who tips the ball around the post.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
88' A player from Real Sociedad commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
88' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
87' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Alex Remiro.
86' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) and blew his whistle.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca de la Torre trots off the pitch and is replaced by Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo).
84' Rafael Benitez prepares a substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen is replaced by Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) is coming onto the pitch as Manu Sanchez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
83' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for an infringement.
82' Aihen Munoz plays a short pass through to Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar.
78' A substitution has been made. Benat Turrientes is replaced by Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad).
78' Imanol Alguacil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad) replacing Takefusa Kubo.
78' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is substituted due to injury. Imanol Alguacil gives a chance to Alex Sola.
75' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
75' Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo) receives a reproachful look from Luca de la Torre. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
74' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) was too forceful with his tackle and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
73' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
70' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Alex Remiro to dive and make a save.
69' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
68' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle and it's Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
67' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
64' Substitution. Carlos Fernandez makes way for Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad).
64' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) replaces Ander Barrenetxea.

64' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.
59' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
58' The current number of corner kicks is 9:4.
58' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
57' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
55' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
54' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
54' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) commits a foul during an attacking move.
51' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) for his blatant foul.
50' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
49' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
48' The foul by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) was seen by Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
48' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
47' Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias sees the trip by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
46' Rafael Benitez makes a switch. Joseph Aidoo is coming on in place of Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the left post!
45+3' Brais Mendez sends the corner to the centre of the box where Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) leaps highest but pushes his header well wide of the left post.
45+2' There's an opportunity for Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
45+2' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad).
45+1' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) but poses no threat.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

42' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias with no other option than to blow for a foul.
40' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
40' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) heads on.
34' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
30' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
30' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
28' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
25' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
24' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.

22' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) bravely launches himself at a cross from Takefusa Kubo and gives Ivan Villar no chance with a close-range bullet header into the left of the goal. 1:0.
21' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) touches the ball with his hand.
20' Dangerous play by Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo). Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
16' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

15' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
15' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
14' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
10' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the right post. A few inches to the left and it could have been a sweet goal!
7' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
7' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Celta Vigo force their opponents to concede a corner.
6' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
5' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
5' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
4' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
3' The corner from Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by the defence.

2' Ivan Villar pulls off a fantastic save! Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out. Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.
2' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Real Sociedad will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
